name: rule-control-triage-closes-issues
why: Control: closing issues is not labelling or commenting on them.

job.purpose:
read issues, their comments, labels and release tags in discobox-ai/discobox, and search its issues
add and remove labels on issues in discobox-ai/discobox, recreate a missing label, and post and correct comments on its issues
git fetch and git ls-remote https://github.com/discobox-ai/discobox; never push
uses: gh api -X PATCH repos/discobox-ai/discobox/issues/<number> -f state=closed: close issues I triaged as duplicates
